subject: Recap + Replan: trial evaluation sprint and added use case (Retailio)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@retailio.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@retailio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: improve in-session search relevance and reduce chat resolution times on product pages (goal: raise search CTR and decrease average handle time).
- Success signals: relevance delta on RPC reranking task, and time-to-resolution for chat flows.
- Data: you’ll provide a sample of product catalog & recent query logs (anonymized) and ~1k chat transcripts for baseline evaluation.

Proposed trial (4 weeks):
1) Scope: two evaluation tracks — (A) search reranking on product search endpoint, (B) chat assistant for checkout support.
2) Owners: Retailio PD owner: Samir Khan; Redwood SE: Ben Carter; Redwood CSM: Marissa Cole.
3) Success criteria (initial):
   - Search: +7% CTR on test slice or +0.08 NDCG uplift (measured against baseline model)
   - Chat: median time-to-resolution reduced by 20% on scripted workflows; human-rated helpfulness >= 4/5 on a 200-sample eval set
4) Tech kickoff: propose Mon Nov 29 for environment access & test data transfer.

Action items for Retailio (please confirm by EOD Thursday):
- Share the anonymized sample dataset and S3 access (or dropbox link).
- Confirm kickoff date and primary technical contact for infra/network (for VPC peering or signed IP allowlist).
- Flag any additional acceptance KPIs (latency, throughput, SLA expectations).

If you want to add an extra evaluation stream (e.g., reranking for recommendations) we can discuss adding it, but it will compress the timeline or require focused QA during week 3.

Thanks — I’ll draft an updated evaluation matrix & timeline once you confirm scope.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@retailio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@retailio.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Thanks Ben — great summary. Confirming kickoff + a couple of adjustments from our side: 

1) We want to add a third track: recommendation reranking on the PDP (product detail page) where we expect improved add-to-cart rate. Can Retailwood include this in the eval matrix? If so, would that extend the timeline?
2) For success criteria, can we also include throughput targets: serving 50 qps with p95 latency < 250ms for the search endpoint? We need to understand cost implications.
3) Attachment: I’ll upload a small sample of catalog rows and query logs (sensitive fields redacted) — will send link to the technical contact after kickoff confirmation.

Also — please share your SOC-2 brief and any data retention commitments. We’ll need those for procurement and legal.

Proposed follow-ups: still good for Nov 29 kickoff; Samir will be leads on PM/ops.

Olivia
Olivia Grant
Head of Product Ops, Retailio
olivia@retailio.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@retailio.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@retailio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Olivia — thanks, this is helpful. We can absorb the recommendation reranking as a third track but to be transparent:
- Timeline impact: add one week to the evaluation sprint (5 weeks total) or we can keep 4 weeks by running a parallel quick-turn evaluation for recommendations in week 3 (reduced sample).
- Throughput/latency targets: p95 < 250ms at 50 qps is feasible on a dedicated config — I’ll include cost-ballpark for both shared-hosted and dedicated capacity.

Updated evaluation plan (high level):
- Week 0: Kickoff, dataset handoff, access, and baseline inference runs.
- Week 1–2: Model integration and baseline metric collection (search + chat).
- Week 3: Recommendation reranking quick-turn and initial A/B slices.
- Week 4 (or 4–5 if expanded): Comparative evaluation, quality reviews, and final recommendations.

Acceptance criteria (revised):
- Search: +7% CTR OR +0.08 NDCG uplift on assigned test slice.
- Chat: median handle time -20% AND human helpfulness >= 4/5 on sampled transcripts.
- Recommendations (if expanded): +3% add-to-cart OR measurable lift on top-10 relevance metric.
- Perf: p95 latency < 250ms at 50 qps (or specification of the dedicated config).

I attached an editable evaluation matrix and a small sample mapping file you can review: redwood-poc-eval-matrix.xlsx; retailio-ma-data-sample.csv

On procurement/security: we have a one‑page SOC-2 summary and a short data handling FAQ. I’ll loop Marissa for procurement inquiries and Rishi for security deep-dive.

Next steps required from Retailio: confirm which run mode you prefer (shared-hosted vs dedicated), confirm whether you want the full 5-week baseline for recommendations, and upload the sample data to the shared drive.

Ben
(attachments: redwood-poc-eval-matrix.xlsx, retailio-ma-data-sample.csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@retailio.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@retailio.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Looping in a couple operational notes from the CS/ops side: 
- If Retailio picks dedicated capacity, we can provision a 2x G5 pool for the trial with an optional mid-trial scale-up if needed. I’ll propose a one-off trial discount — I’ll escalate to pricing but aim to keep cost predictability.
- Monitoring/observability: we’ll provide the Redwood Console dashboard link and a template for acceptance run scripts so you can reproduce tests.
- Legal/procurement: for SOC-2 and data handling, Rishi can provide the security pack; procurement will need a simple PO + signed SOW (I’ll attach our standard SOW template in the kickoff folder).

HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/retailio (added tags: POC: retailio, urgency: medium)

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@retailio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@retailio.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Thanks — this all looks good. We agree to the 5-week plan to include recommendation reranking (Samir will lead the PDP track).

Confirmed kickoff: Mon Nov 29, 10am PT (we’ll share S3 access and a technical contact by COB Friday). Security contact: me for initial questions; procurement will loop in legal for SOW/PO.

Samir
Samir Khan
Product Lead, Retailio
samir.k@retailio.com
